summary: INT. CROWNLIGHT ATRIUM – BASTION SPIRE – CORE – DAY. Sunlight pours through stained-glass crowns, casting the floor in blue, gold, red, silver.
settingText: INT. CROWNLIGHT ATRIUM – BASTION SPIRE – CORE – DAY

dialogueInline.speaker: Archivist Selen Stormwell
dialogueInline.text: We promised we would not forget the silence. Not the dark without heat, the wards without light, the clinics without antiseptic. We promised corridors open, and names remembered.

dialogueInline.speaker: Archivist Selen Stormwell
dialogueInline.text: And when memory and mercy disagree, we test which one keeps people alive.

directionInline: Sunlight pours through stained-glass crowns, casting the floor in blue, gold, red, silver. A quiet crowd: officers, citizens, survivors. ARCHIVIST SELEN STORMWELL stands at a lectern, a chain of stamped memorial tags over her shoulders. A bell tone. Doors part. ADMIRAL CAEL DOMINION enters, robes of the Aurelian Crown rigid as sculpture. Behind him: ADMIRAL TEYRA SOLENNE (Ember), ADMIRAL SARIEN KORR (Cerulean), ADMIRAL KADE RHYNE (Aegis). COMMODORE ILYRA VENN watches from the side aisle, no fanfare. The Admirals continue past, into the Council chambers.

dialogueInline.speaker: Admiral Sarien Korr
